items.title: Frank Alkyer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Orleans, Louisiana, January 10, 2020
items.q: luckily we’re still a family-owned publication. The Maher family, Kevin Maher owns it, his father owned it before him, his grandfather owned it before him.

ctx.x: What the heck was that? Well okay let’s just like throw another 70 or 80 years of jazz history on top of that and you go, we can’t, no, we’re just going to go — luckily we’re still a family-owned publication. The Maher family, Kevin Maher owns it, his father owned it before him, his grandfather owned it before him. And so, and they’re not jazz people. They’re business people. And they’ve stayed — but they’ve always stayed out of the way and they’ve always had an appreciation for good editorial, that they thought…
